sources.title: AI Model Release Calendar: Latest AI Model Releases by Date
sources.snippet: This AI model release calendar tracks major model launches across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, SpaceXAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Moonshot AI, Meta, Mistral AI, MiniMax, and other important AI labs. You can use the newest-first tables to find the release date, provider, release stage, and model type.

sources.title: GitHub - Bairavi05/Sentiment-Analysis: A complete end-to-end sentiment ...
sources.snippet: A complete sentiment analysis system that predicts six emotions — sad, joy, love, anger, fear, surprise — using a hybrid model combining Machine Learning, LSTM, and Ensemble Voting. The project includes a ready-to-use Streamlit web app.

sources.title: GitHub - BenWiseman/sentiment.ai: Package for using deep learning ...
sources.snippet: The most complete on-device sentiment toolkit in the R/Python ecosystem. It ships hate-speech / mixed / style flags, intent-based profiles, an interactive sentiment map, and opt-in transformer backends for when you want maximum accuracy. The default model, on-device e5-base, matches the paid OpenAI embedding (text-embedding-3-small) on our benchmarks: that quality, free, across ~100 languages ...
